_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Showing the pictures on the TV…

description: Show up to 50 photos and videos one after another: each photo stays for its duration_s (default 8 s), each video plays to the end. The viewer can skip with ←/→ on the remote. Public https:// links only. Returns an id.

items.description: The photos and videos in order.

type.description: Optional; guessed from the link when missing.

url.description: Public https:// URL of an image or a video (file, HLS or DASH).

name: show_queue
title: Show several photos and videos
